preflight_permissions: 新增修改 ios/** 檔案(含引入 whisper.cpp 原始碼)
執行 xcodebuild 與網路驗證命令
Drive→mirror 複製並於 mirror commit(push 另請示)

acceptance.desc: C1 xcodebuild -project ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj -scheme SaySomething -sdk iphonesimulator build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO 於 Drive 與 mirror 皆 exit 0

evidence.cmd: xcodebuild -project ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj -scheme SaySomething -sdk iphonesimulator build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

acceptance.desc: C2 whisper.cpp 只編進主 App target,鍵盤 target 不含 whisper/ggml 任何檔(pbxproj 佐證)

evidence.cmd: python3 -c "import re; t=open('ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj').read(); kb=re.search(r'8EDFC8067FD901FC53B011CC /\\* Sources \\*/ = \\{.*?\\};', t, re.S).group(0); app=re.search(r'B4F15E9C125149069915B229 /\\* Sources \\*/ = \\{.*?\\};', t, re.S).group(0); kb_hits=len(re.findall(r'whisper|ggml', kb, re.I)); app_hits=len(re.findall(r'whisper|ggml', app, re.I)); print('keyboard_target_whisper_ggml_refs=', kb_hits); print('app_target_whisper_ggml_refs=', app_hits); assert kb_hits == 0, 'keyboard target must have zero whisper/ggml refs'; assert app_hits > 0, 'app target must reference whisper/ggml'"

acceptance.desc: C3 轉錄管線:錄音檔經 AVAudioConverter 轉 16kHz mono Float32 → whisper 轉錄,語言參數接設定;失敗有中文錯誤訊息

evidence.cmd: grep -c 'sampleRate: 16_000' ios/SaySomething/WhisperTranscriber.swift && grep -c 'commonFormat: .pcmFormatFloat32' ios/SaySomething/WhisperTranscriber.swift && grep -c 'params.language = langPtr' ios/SaySomething/WhisperTranscriber.swift && grep -c 'whisper_full(ctx, params' ios/SaySomething/WhisperTranscriber.swift && grep -c 'enum WhisperError: LocalizedError' ios/SaySomething/WhisperTranscriber.swift

acceptance.desc: C4 GeminiClient 新增純文字潤飾路徑;設定頁有「轉錄方式」開關(本地 whisper 預設/雲端 Gemini 送音檔),雲端原路徑保留可用

evidence.cmd: grep -c 'static func polishText' ios/SaySomething/GeminiClient.swift && grep -c 'static func transcribeAndPolish' ios/SaySomething/GeminiClient.swift && grep -c 'transcriptionMode' ios/SaySomething/Settings.swift && grep -c '轉錄方式' ios/SaySomething/SettingsView.swift && grep -c 'tag("cloud")' ios/SaySomething/SettingsView.swift

acceptance.desc: C5 模型下載管理:官方 ggml 模型 URL(執行者需 curl -I 驗證可達並記證據),下載進度 UI,存 Application Support,可刪除重下;App 不打包模型檔

evidence.cmd: curl -sIL --max-time 30 -o /dev/null -w "small_q5_1_status=%{http_code}\n" "https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-small-q5_1.bin" && curl -sIL --max-time 30 -o /dev/null -w "base_q5_1_status=%{http_code}\n" "https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-base-q5_1.bin" && test -z "$(find ios -iname "*.bin")" && echo "no_bin_bundled=true" && grep -c "applicationSupportDirectory" ios/SaySomething/ModelManager.swift && grep -c "func startDownload" ios/SaySomething/ModelManager.swift && grep -c "func delete" ios/SaySomething/ModelManager.swift && grep -c "downloadProgress" ios/SaySomething/ModelManager.swift

acceptance.desc: C6 記憶體策略:whisper context 用完即釋放(load-per-use),程式碼可佐證;無常駐大配置

evidence.cmd: grep -n 'defer { whisper_free(ctx) }' ios/SaySomething/WhisperTranscriber.swift && ! grep -n 'var.*whisper_context\|static.*ctx' ios/SaySomething/WhisperTranscriber.swift ios/SaySomething/ModelManager.swift | grep -v '//' | grep -qi 'whisper_context \*'

acceptance.desc: C7 Prompts 單源不變;純文字潤飾 prompt 與音檔版七模式語意一致

evidence.cmd: grep -c "static let modes" ios/SaySomething/Prompts.swift && grep -c "Prompts.buildSystem" ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift | paste -sd+ | bc && grep -c "func transcribeAndPolish\|func polishText" ios/SaySomething/GeminiClient.swift && grep -c "GeminiClient.polishText(apiKey: apiKey, model: model, system: system" ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift
